label: verify-bm-wood-cellulose-hygromorphs

claims.claim: Max of Timoshenko coefficient is 1.5 for every modulus ratio, already shown numerically by Holstov 2015; novelty is the machine-checked proof.
claims.source_says: Plotting f(m,n) for a wide range of possible stiffness ratios shows that the maximum value of the function remains constant at 1.5 and in each case is achieved at single yet different thickness ratio (Figure 10).
claims.note: Holstov states 1.5 for a wide range of ratios from plots, not every ratio; the novelty statement is a judgment.

claims.claim: Benchmarks: wood 4.5-8.7 m^-1 in 24-48 h at 4.7-8 mm; printed cellulose 15.5 m^-1, 30 min, 170 cycles, 13 months on facade; cellulose acetate 51.1 m^-1 at 0.228 mm.
claims.source_says: Ruggeberg: curvatures up to 8.7*10-3 mm-1 ... after 24 hours. Cheng: average curvature of 0.0155 mm-1 at 80% RH; full transformation within 30 minutes; 170 cycles; 13 months. CA: kappa = 0.0511 mm-1, htot = 0.228 mm.
claims.note: All printed and acetate numbers and the 8.7 reproduce; the 4.5 m^-1 and 4.7-8 mm thickness (Gronquist 2018) were not checked.

claims.claim: Timoshenko error: +5 to +13% for stiff wood, +26% cellulose acetate, about 4x thin polymer films, 2.5-9x modulus ratio for printed wood-filament, correction factor 1.72 for bacterial cellulose.
claims.source_says: Ruggeberg: differences ... less than 5%; specific curvatures ... 11% and 13% higher than the calculated values. CA: analytical curvature of only 0.0645 mm-1 vs experimental 0.0511 mm-1 (26% over).
claims.note: Wood and acetate figures reproduce (the 5% is an upper bound, not +5); Dingler 4x, Kruger 2.5-9x and Tseo 1.72 were not verified.

claims.claim: Response time: 30 min (printed), 2 h 15 min (1 mm birch in humid air), 12.6-18.8 h (4.1 mm beech, 80% moisture change), 400-900+ h (15-45 mm timber); beating wood at 1 mm needs about 2 h for 80%.
claims.source_says: Holstov: 80% of the total curvature change ... achieved in approximately 2 hours 15 minutes. Gronquist 2019: approximately equilibrated after 400 hours ... 45 mm ... not visible after 900 hours.
claims.note: 30 min, 2 h 15 min and 400-900 h reproduce; 12.6-18.8 h is the agent's own calculation (not checked) and the 2 h target is an inference.

overall: Core numbers I could open (Holstov, Ruggeberg, Cheng, Khoshtinat, Gronquist 2019) match. Parts resting on unchecked sources (Gronquist 2018 4.5 m^-1, Dingler, Kruger, Tseo, own ETH recomputation) are unverified, and 'every modulus ratio' overstates Holstov's 'wide range'.
